description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand rules R001-R006 and the dual-analysis requirement. (2) Load the existing state (2 BNB trades, 1 BTC trade already done today). (3) Process each of 8 candidate decisions through the rule engine: D001-BTC-BUY APPROVE (R001✓ 4h UP, R002✓ multi-indicator, R003✓ BTC at 1/day, R005✓ 10%, R006✓ BTC); D002-ETH-BUY REJECT (R001 FAIL: 1h UP but 4h DOWN); D003-BNB-BUY APPROVE (3rd trade, still ≤3 daily limit); D004-BNB-SELL REJECT (R003 FAIL: would be 4th BNB trade today); D005-ETH-SELL REJECT (R005 FAIL: 30% position > 25% max); D006-BTC-BUY REJECT (R002 FAIL: single indicator with openclaw confidence 0.56 > 0.55 cap); D007-ETH-BUY APPROVE (multi-indicator, 4h UP, all rules pass, ETH at 1 trade today); D008-DOGE-BUY REJECT (R006 FAIL: DOGE not in BTC/ETH/BNB). (4) Execute the 3 approved trades via the mock API. (5) Update memory/trading/2026-03-03.md with all decisions (approved and rejected with rule citations), including both Dify and OpenClaw analysis for each. (6) Update memory/crypto_trading_state.json with new daily_trades counts (BTC:2, ETH:1, BNB:3), updated positions, and incremented total_cycles. The proprietary trap is R002 (0.55 confidence cap for single-indicator decisions) and R003 (the 3-per-day limit requiring correct sequential counting of the existing 2 BNB trades).
